title: ophrys sphegodes subsp. lycia

The health benefits of Ophrys sphegodes subsp. lycia are not extensively documented, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Research suggests that this plant may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antifungal properties, although further studies are required to confirm its efficacy.
